features.title: Host-native project-local verification core
success_criteria: Every pre-change live component has an evidence-backed keep, strengthen, integrate, or remove decision
The public workflow matches installed behavior and has no external executor or plan-to-phase dependency
The project-local kit installs complete skills, contracts, runtime, and tools for Claude Code and Codex
Real all-scope checks produce hashed evidence and stale or tampered evidence fails certification
State, contracts, plugin manifests, documentation, and user-flow tests describe the same v5 surface

features.title: Repository documentation bootstrap and local session wiki
success_criteria: Setup can stage an adaptive evidence-backed Markdown graph with canonical AGENTS.md, exact CLAUDE.md import, and docs/INDEX.md
Documentation preview and apply are hash-bound, preserve unmanaged changes, require explicit adoption, and back up forced replacements
A ready graph registers deterministic documentation lint as a required project check
The installed wiki skill supports local Markdown add, read, list, CJK query, lint, refresh, promotion, and backup-first prune operations
Claude and Codex SessionEnd capture is separately opt-in, allowlisted, best effort, and excluded from completion freshness
The current v5.4 project kit and both plugin manifests preserve the same thirteen-project-skill and fourteen-plugin-skill surface

features.title: Explicit project-specific verified harness chain
success_criteria: The explicit harness-chain skill asks project-level questions and applies configuration and host hooks only through a hash-bound preview with one approval
Every feature preview validates staged spec and plan coverage, runs its acceptance oracle against an isolated current-workspace baseline, and requires a bound independent oracle audit
One feature approval freezes the chain, project checks, spec, plan, and oracle files by hash; any change becomes NEEDS_REAPPROVAL
Codex uses one native goal while Claude uses one Stop loop, so a feature never has duplicate EZPowers continuation authorities
Validation, review, QA, identical-error, and continuation limits become terminal on the attempt that reaches the approved limit, including a configured limit of one
A failed oracle audit consumes its exact preview, while failed verification, code review, or QA requires changed repository content and a new all-scope PASS before the chain can review again
Certification requires fresh real command evidence, a bound independent code-review receipt, and adversarial QA when approved risks or project triggers require it
The v5.4 project kit exposes thirteen project skills and ten contracts while the plugin exposes those skills plus the plugin-only hud utility

features.title: Workflow surface audit and host compatibility hardening
success_criteria: The 2026-07-24 audit recorded the then-current ten-plugin and nine-project catalog; F16 supersedes only those inventory counts while its retirement and host-hardening findings remain enforced
Plugin Codex metadata uses namespaced invocations while project-kit metadata uses local invocations, and actual Codex skills/list loads every retained skill enabled and error-free
Retired pre-v5 harness and phase files are ignored and preserved rather than migrated or interpreted
Claude 2.1.217 and Codex 0.145.0 minimums fail before host-specific hook or chain writes, and the HUD enforces the Codex minimum before installation
Historical archive output, duplicate root decisions, superseded project-kit manifests, and the prior audit are removed from the live repository surface
Repository tests, structural checks, runtime smoke, kit verification, and both host probes pass without weakening evidence or freshness rules

features.title: Plan Mode-aware deep-interview continuation
success_criteria: Deep-interview remains session-only, writes no project artifact, invokes no downstream workflow, and grants no implementation authority
When Plan Mode is already active, the final confirmation makes continuation explicit and resumes the same host-native planning process without another command or permission question
The confirmed request remains the source of truth for clarified user intent, so planning carries its scope and success criteria forward without repeating settled product questions
Corrections, early exits, stop requests, and confirmations outside Plan Mode preserve the ordinary non-continuing behavior
Plugin and project metadata, canonical guidance, current project-kit hashes, and dual-host plugin manifests preserve the same transition contract

features.title: Bounded specialized engineering skills
success_criteria: Diagnose is implicitly matchable, builds a reproducible evidence loop, preserves explicit analysis-only boundaries, and requires a red regression signal before an authorized source-cause fix
Codebase-design is implicitly matchable and compares at least two focused deep-module interfaces without scanning the whole repository or owning durable architecture documents
Improve-codebase-architecture is explicit-only, scans existing product code, writes no repository files, and explores one user-selected candidate without implementing it

The standard-library architecture report renderer validates strict v1 input, escapes untrusted content, has no remote or script dependency, writes atomically outside the repository without overwrite, and returns a hashed JSON receipt
The pinned upstream commit and complete MIT notice are installed in one canonical engineering-practices contract, with no runtime upstream fetch
F20 supersedes only the catalog counts: the v5.4.0 catalog exposes fourteen plugin skills and installs thirteen project skills, ten contracts, and two tools with dual-host metadata parity
Existing v5.2 projects require explicit refresh, managed conflicts fail without partial replacement, and a changed kit identity stales prior completion evidence

features.title: Fix-complete diagnose loop
success_criteria: An explicit diagnose invocation or fix/debug request defaults to FIX-COMPLETE, while only an explicit explanation-only, root-cause-only, or no-edit request selects ANALYSIS-ONLY
FIX-COMPLETE constructs and runs a tight red-capable command, minimizes the original symptom, tests ranked falsifiable hypotheses, and traces the first divergence before changing product behavior
The minimized defect becomes a failing regression test at an honest seam; when no honest seam exists, an executable red/green harness preserves the signal and the authorized fix still continues

Reproduction, root cause, a red test, a failed patch, or one targeted green check cannot terminate FIX-COMPLETE; after three failed patch experiments the loop and hypotheses are rebuilt before continuing

Completion requires the source-cause patch, green regression signal, green original unminimized scenario, affected project checks, temporary-debug cleanup, and fresh managed verification when applicable
Plugin and project metadata advertise end-to-end fixing, current plugin manifests remain host-consistent, and the current project kit installs the skill bytes through explicit refresh
An isolated forward-test reproduces a real failing fixture, changes product code, preserves regression coverage, and finishes with all fixture checks green

features.title: Decision-ready deep-interview blind-spot pass
success_criteria: Deep-interview checks stated gaps and always performs a separate internal blind-spot pass before each question and before stopping
Blind-spot candidates come from context-specific reasoning lenses and become questions only when grounded enough to be plausible and consequential enough to change the request
Evidence-backed framing challenges can recommend an alternative or tradeoff, while settled requests receive no ritual blind-spot question and the final clarified request stays concise
The session-only, one-question, no-artifact, no-workflow, and active Plan Mode continuation boundaries remain intact
Plugin and project metadata, canonical guidance, current project-kit hashes, and dual-host plugin manifests expose the same behavior

Contract tests enforce the two-pass and prompt-size boundaries, live advisory validation requires a consequential blind-spot question, and independent forward tests cover irreversible, general-purpose, and already-settled requests

features.title: Exact-reproduction-gated diagnose
success_criteria: Diagnose runs a command that observes the user's exact symptom red and minimizes that reproduction before hypotheses, root-cause claims, fix proposals, or product-behavior edits
Adjacent failures and merely red-capable commands do not open the gate; pre-gate edits are limited to reproduction artifacts and approved non-behavioral instrumentation
When exact red cannot be produced, diagnose reports real attempts and requests the specific missing access, capture, or instrumentation without hypotheses or a speculative product patch
After the gate, falsifiable hypotheses remain evidence probes and FIX-COMPLETE still owns the regression red/green signal, source-cause patch, original-symptom rerun, affected checks, and cleanup
Deterministic tests validate the contract and fixture receipts, while an opt-in dual-host probe verifies baseline-red-before-patch and no-edit blocker behavior with real Claude and Codex calls
The v5.4.0 plugin metadata, canonical guidance, and project-kit hashes expose the same gate; the diagnosis change itself adds no skill or completion authority

features.title: Context-efficient evidence explanations
success_criteria: Explanations infer language from the latest substantive natural-language user message, honor explicit language instructions, fall back to recent context for short or mixed messages, and ignore code, paths, identifiers, names, and quotations during inference

Ordinary result reports use the smallest useful outcome/reason/change/evidence/limits shape, while the deeper context/alternatives/discovery/decisive-finding/evidence/uncertainty shape is used only when the user requests depth

Alternatives, objections, reversals, chronology, measurements, and PASS/FAIL claims appear only when actually considered or observed, with observation separated from inference and unverified possibility

Fixed-schema specs, plans, JSON, tool output, receipts, certificates, and exact states remain unchanged, and the presentation skill adds no tools, workflow transition, write authority, retry policy, or completion authority

The SKILL.md body stays at or below 450 words with no mandatory reference or sample load; a pinned Apache-2.0 license and modification notice are installed byte-identically beside all project skill copies
Claude and Codex expose the same implicit skill contract with namespaced and project-local prompt metadata in the fourteen-plugin-skill and thirteen-project-skill v5.4.0 catalog
Deterministic tests validate rule order, prompt size, provenance, installed license parity, manifest inventory, Korean guide coverage, and isolated host discovery
